_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: east_asian (sinitic) backbone + north_american (plains) overlay (cross-family blend, Sinitic-leaning)

blend.backbone: east_asian (sinitic / Chinese register: the Huangdi over wang and the five peerages, the Celestial-Mandate court and Confucian bureaucracy, monosyllabic (C)(G)V(C) morphemes with -n/-ng codas, surname-first dithematic-free names, -di/-jun/-wang celestial titles)
blend.overlay: north_american (plains horse-nomads, Comanche-leaning: the buffalo-grass and the open sky, the warrior-societies and chiefs'-council, the puuku-horse and kutsu-bison, descriptive deed-names, the vision-quest puha)
blend.lean: Sinitic-heavy - a dragon-court mandarinate enthroned over the horse-clans of the great plains: the silk-banner Celestial Mandate rules from its walled cheng, the eagle-feather horse-chiefs and their grass-and-herd bands serve and ride beneath, their plain/beast/mountain/material words enduring under the Mandarin tongue.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_09 Jinxia (Sinitic / Chinese) x BASE_11 Numina (Plains horse-nomads). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Chinese base = Civilized, Plains base = Clanhold, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Longmani is Civilized (feudal). Concept: the dragon-court and the great-plains sky - a Sinitic Celestial-Mandate realm whose mandarins and walled cities have absorbed the horse-clans of the open grass; the silk banner flies over the eagle-feather, the mandarin commands beside the horse-chief, the Confucian bureaucracy taxes the buffalo-bands. Backbone = Sinitic (Chinese: the ruling Huangdi/wang court, the five peerages, the scribal mandarinate, the celestial titles); overlay/substrate = Plains (the horse-and-bison clans, the warrior-societies, the open-sky vision-religion, the grass/mountain/beast/material words). Common-word lexicon is a SINGLE fused tongue (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Sinitic reflexes PRIMARY, Plains variants SECONDARY), never real Chinese/Plains gods. NO approved foreign rank-term applies to this pairing - ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English; the fused conlang ladder lives in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. UPDATE 2026-06-28: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; deities via the per-family morph method (Sinitic primary, Plains secondary).

phonology.palette: Sinitic backbone - monosyllabic morphemes, syllable (C)(G)V(C) with only -n/-ng codas, tones (unmarked), initials incl. zh/ch/sh/x/q/j, NO consonant clusters, surname(1) + given(1-2), celestial titles -di/-jun/-wang - meeting a Plains overlay: Comanche roots (paa water, toya mountain, soni grass, puuku horse, kutsu bison, taabe sun), the barred-u vowel, glottal stops, CV(C) deed-names. Per the CSV: harsh texture with tonal contours - the sharp Sinitic affricates and tonal monosyllables carry Plains roots that have been clipped to fit; grammar shifts toward an SOV polysynthetic isolating frame, the Plains compounding-stems strung onto the isolating Sinitic court-register. Theophoric on the Sinitic celestial reflexes (Tuli-, Aolan-) with Plains vision-name variants (Torawi-, Olanta-).
phonology.phonotactics: (C)(G)V(C) monosyllables, -n/-ng codas only, no clusters (Sinitic dominant); Plains roots compressed to one or two Sinitic-legal syllables, barred-u -> -u/-o, glottal stops and final -bi/-pu/-tu/-kahni endings dropped; tonal contour-stress with a Plains descriptive compounding pull; surname-first court names over toya-/paa-/soni- Plains feature-stems under -cheng/-shan/-jiang toponyms.

sound_changes: Plains exotic phonemes -> Sinitic inventory: barred-u (u) > -u/-o, glottal-stop > 0, doubled vowels (aa/uu) > single
Plains polysyllabic class-endings drop: final -bi/-pu/-bo/-tu/-kahni > 0; roots clip to one or two (C)(G)V(C) syllables with -n/-ng codas only
Sinitic tonal monosyllabic shape on all words; no consonant clusters; Sinitic affricates (zh/ch/sh/x/q/j) permitted; Plains stems that end in a vowel may take a Sinitic -n
retain the Sinitic -di/-jun/-wang court-suffixes and a few signature Plains roots (toya, soni, puku, kutsu, taabe) so both ancestries stay audible
fusion_rules.source_tilt: plain/beast/mountain/material/staple words from Plains roots (the grass-and-herd substrate works the land and rides the horse): toya(mountain), soni(grass-plain), puku(horse), kutsu(bison), sari(hide), tunap(drymeat); rule/kin/court/land/water/abstract words from Sinitic roots (the ruling Mandarin register): jia(house), cheng(city), jiang(river), da(great), sheng(sacred); every root then filtered to one Sinitic-shaped phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Plains plain/beast/mountain/material/staple-roots + Sinitic rule/kin/court/land-roots, all clipped to one Sinitic-shaped tonal monosyllabic phonology; portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline (the dragon-court married to the horse-clan).

morphology.patronymic_form: the Sinitic ruling court keeps a clan-surname (xing) first + given name, with generation-names in the zu lineage; the Plains horse-clans keep the band/division name (e.g. Kwahada) and the earned deed- or vision-name; the throne fuses both - a xing-surnamed mandarin-house that also claims a horse-band's deed-name.
morphology.compounding_rule: Sinitic quality/feature + type ([quality]-cheng, Bei-guan) layered over Plains [quality|animal] + feature stems (Eka-tuya red-mountain, Kutsu-soni bison-grassland): the capital Longmani (Dragon-of-the-grass / dragon-people), Jin-cheng (golden-city), Tuya-nuki (the mountain-camp).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Sinitic Celestial-Mandate court over the Plains horse-clans: the Huangdi over wang and the five peerages at the crown, the mandarin-governors over the cheng-cities, the warrior-society horse-chiefs and band-paraibo sworn beneath; the Confucian bureaucracy and the open-sky puha-seers serve the throne)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Sinitic court ladder, ascending, with the Plains horse-clan chief co-titles fused beneath. Nan-tan (the baron-nan crossed with the Apache nantan band-chief) barony; Dudu-wap (the frontier dudu military-commandant crossed with the Comanche tekwuniwap war chief) march; Bo-paraibo (count-bo as band peace-chief) county; Hou-akita (marquis-hou over the akicita warrior-societies) duchy; Gong-paraibo (duke-gong as great-chief over several bands) principality; Wang-naika (the wang-king crossed with the Tabe-Naika head-chief) kingdom over a Wangguo; Huang-Tabe-di (the Huangdi crossed with the Pia-Tabe-Naika grand head-chief) empire over the Diguo, holding the Mandate of Heaven (Tianming). The conquered horse-clans keep their paraibo (peace-chief) and puhakatu (medicine-seer) beneath the dragon-court. Rank titles fuse the real Chinese and Plains registers (allowed).
title_ladder.heir: Taizi-tua (the crown prince; the throne's son and heir)

honorifics.elder: Kuchu-zu (the eldest; Sinitic gu-zu over Plains kuhtsu)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH. No approved foreign term applies to this pairing, so English display titles are used throughout; the *_native fused conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Sinitic ruling court carry a clan-surname (xing) first + given name (+ courtesy-name zi); the Plains horse-clans carry a band/division name + an earned deed/vision-name; order given the court-register surname-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Sinitic mandarin-court keep xing + ming + a courtesy-name (zi) and sobriquet (hao); the Plains horse-clans keep a band-name + an earned deed- or vision-name (animal + quality), rendered in the usual way.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Sinitic devotional invoking the celestial reflexes' virtues rather than the god-name directly (Tian-en, heaven's grace; a temple-name honoring Tuli-di); Plains vision-sign names under the powers (a war-vision under Maraksa, the morphed Maraxus).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Sinitic celestial reflexes PRIMARY (family_east_asian.json theonym_sets.sinitic), Plains variants SECONDARY (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.plains), never real Chinese/Plains gods. A Celestial Bureaucracy under the Mandate of Heaven married to the open-sky vision-religion: the One (Aiteng / Plains Ateruna) presides as Highest Heaven; the Lawful powers are the celestial officials (-di emperors, -jun lords) AND the sky-and-earth powers met on the high plain; the Neutral honor the ancestral zu and the band-dead through Confucian rite and the vision-quest (puha) alike.
religion.the_one: Aiteng (< Aeternus; the Highest Heaven, source of the Mandate; Plains Ateruna, the Great-Above - served not petitioned)

Gaiandus.gloss: the Earth Emperor, lord of mountains

Numeno.gloss: the Sage Lord of the winds

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aiteng the Highest Heaven, Tuli-di the just sun, Aolan-jun of the sworn war, Lianta-mu the merciful (Plains Torawi, Olanta, Reawina honored at the high plain) - and names the Chaotic powers mo (demon-marshals) or the war-fire raiders, warded; the Mandate's law and the medicine-bond bind alike
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral zu (the deified court-dead and band-dead) and the local earth-and-grain powers and animal-spirits; the great powers invoked at the Miao-temple and the vision-bluff situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon - Maluo the war-fire (Plains Maraksa), the raider-marshals - and names the Lawful powers and Aiteng/Ateruna as the cold sky-tyrants and the throne's chains, to be defied.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as mo (Sinitic demon-marshals) or the demonized sky-tyrants (Plains), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maluo the War-Fire Marshal (Plains Maraksa the Raider); Vacidus -> Wuci the Devourer (Plains Vachita the Empty-Maw); Lusanto -> Lusan the Coin-Serpent (Plains Lusanta the Greed-Worm).

clergy_ladder.7: Gaogong (high priest) / Numunu-puhakatu (the band's high seer)
clergy_ladder.9: Tianshi (celestial master) / Naika-puhakatu (the council's great seer)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Miao (temple) of [power] in the cheng-cities: 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine) for the zu; on the open plain, the medicine-cairn or vision-bluff of [power]: 'the Medicine-Bluff of Maraksa'.
religion.saints_pattern: deified heroes and worthy officials enrolled in the celestial register, AND the great horse-chiefs and vision-seers who became sky- and animal-spirits; honored at the Ci (ancestral shrine) and Miao, and at the burial-scaffold and medicine-cairn.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tuli-di: a red sun-disc above the scales and seal of office, ringed by an eagle-feather circle
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaidun-di: a green mountain over the grain-altar and the open grass
holy_symbol_motifs.Aolan-jun: an iron blade crossed with the silk war-banner over a horse-clan lance

banks_patterns.ships: river-junk and war-junk of the great rivers, and the famed war-horses of the plains: 'the Jade Dragon', 'the Heaven-Mandate', 'Storm-Runner' (a famed horse), 'the Grass-Eater'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [general] Ying (camp/army) and the [color] Banner of the court, the warrior-societies of the clans: 'the Tiger Ying', 'the Azure Banner', 'the Dog-Soldiers', 'the Eagle-Feather society'
banks_patterns.taverns: 'The [Adjective] [Noun]': 'The Jade Cup', 'The Dragon and Lance', 'The Plum-Blossom Inn'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen warlord cheng and tomb-mounds, and old burial-scaffolds and spirit-haunted buttes: 'the Ruined Cheng of [warlord]', 'the Tomb of [name]', 'the Ghost-Butte of [chief]'

flagship_settlements: Longmani (the chief seat - the dragon-court of the grass)
